description: AERIUS vaarwegen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by connect.aerius.nl. This web service includes waterways as used in the various AERIUS 2025 products. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "AERIUS waterways" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AERIUS, vaarwegen, scheepvaart. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
